role: privacy-preserving product improvement, sales analytics and proof/heartbeat telemetry policy
invariant: Telemetry never changes scientific truth, proof qualification, account entitlements, wallet balances, or research results.

lanes.purpose: reliability, security, abuse prevention, capacity planning and service health
allowed: error/crash codes and bounded stack fingerprints
proof qualification outcome/status metadata without theorem/proof content
security/audit events required to protect the service

lanes.purpose: improve product, understand feature adoption and inform internal sales/customer-success strategy
allowed: country/region-level aggregate only when lawfully collected
forbidden: private customer identifiers in analyst dashboards
user_controls: honor legally required privacy signals such as GPC where applicable

lanes.purpose: voluntary contribution of reusable proof/research artifacts to improve CACE
lanes.requires: separate explicit project/account opt-in plus contribution terms/IP permission

sales_use.allowed: aggregate/pseudonymous product-usage trends may inform internal sales, customer success, capacity and feature prioritization under the applicable privacy basis
sales_use.prohibited: do not silently sell/share raw user scientific content or proof artifacts as advertising/marketing data
sales_use.dashboards: prefer aggregate cohorts and tenant-safe pseudonyms; restrict analyst access

privacy_engineering.retention: documented per telemetry lane; shortest practical period
privacy_engineering.deletion_export: support applicable user privacy rights for personal telemetry
